title: Triton Inference Response
description: An inference response returned by NVIDIA Triton Inference Server following the KServe V2 inference protocol. Contains the model identification, request correlation ID, and output tensors with their data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the response, matching the corresponding request ID

model_name.description: Name of the model that produced the inference results

model_version.description: Version of the model that produced the inference results

parameters.description: Response-level parameters returned by the server

sequence_id.description: Sequence identifier if this response is part of a sequence

sequence_start.description: Indicates this is the first response in a sequence

sequence_end.description: Indicates this is the last response in a sequence

outputs.description: Output tensors produced by the inference

OutputTensor.description: An output tensor returned by the model after inference

datatype.description: Data type of the tensor elements

binary_data_size.description: Size in bytes of binary data appended after the JSON response body

data.description: Tensor data as a flattened row-major array of values
